title: Isolation and functional characterization of primary endothelial cells from mouse cerebral cortex
protocol: Prepare aliquots of 200 μL Enzyme P from the Neural Dissociation Kit (P) and store at −20°C.
Resuspend lyophilized Enzyme A with 1 mL of Buffer A in provided vial labeled Enzyme A.
Prepare aliquots of 40 μL resuspended Enzyme A solution and store at −20°C.
Thaw SingleQuots™ Kit from the EGM™-2 MV Microvascular Endothelial Cell Growth Medium-2 BulletKit™.
Add thawed SingleQuots™ Kit to basal medium within 72 h.
Mix all dissection tools thoroughly in autoclave before use.
Clean dissection bench using 70% or 100% ethanol.
Submerge dissection tools and razor blade in 100% ethanol for a minimum of 30 min prior to dissection.
Prepare a 12-well plate with 1 mL of cold HBSS (without calcium/magnesium).
Sacrifice the mouse by cervical dislocation.
Transfer the brain into a petri dish containing cold HBSS without calcium/magnesium.
Remove the cerebellum and brain stem, leaving cerebral hemispheres intact.
Bisect cerebral hemispheres along midline using a sterile razor blade.
Place each hemisphere with the medial side facing up.
Using curved forceps remove striatum, hippocampus and thalamus, leaving the cortex intact.
Mince cortex into small pieces using a razor blade.
Transfer minced cortex fragments delicately to a 12-well plate containing 1 mL of cold HBSS without calcium/magnesium.
Repeat the dissection process with the next mouse.
Once all dissections are complete, transfer each pair of minced cortex submerged in cold HBSS from the 12-well plate into a 15 mL conical tube placed on ice using a 3 mL transfer pipette.
Use a razor blade to mince cortical pair into medium-to-small pieces.
Add enzyme mix 1 and 2 to minced tissue.
Pipette up and down approximately 10 times with a 3 mL transfer pipette to dissociate the tissue.
Pipette up and down approximately 10 times with a glass Pasteur pipette to fully dissociate the tissue.
Prepare a 6-well plate for endothelial cell culture.
Add 2 mL of 100% ethanol per well in a 6-well plate.
Incubate the plate at room temperature in the biosafety cabinet for 1 hour.
Aspirate 100% ethanol from each well and let the plate dry.
Prepare 2 wells of a 6-well plate for each pair of cortical hemispheres.
Add 1 mL of 1× attachment factor to each well and let sit at room temperature for 30 min.
Aspirate 1× attachment factor and let plate dry.
Mix 1900 μL of buffer X with 50 μL of enzyme P for a final volume of 1950 μL.
Pre-heat mixture at 37°C for 15 min.
Centrifuge minced cortex at 300×g for 2 min at room temperature and aspirate supernatant.
Add 1950 μL of pre-heated enzyme mix 1 to each tube containing minced cortex.
Incubate minced cortex for 15 min at 37°C.
Tap and gently swirl the tube (∼5 times) to dislodge tissue every 5 min.
Mix 20 μL of buffer Y with 10 μL of enzyme A for a final volume of 30 μL.
Add 30 μL of enzyme mix 2 to each tube containing minced cortex following a 15 min incubation.
Invert the tubes gently.
Dissociate cortical tissue mechanically using a sterile 3 mL plastic transfer pipette, pipetting up and down slowly (∼10 times).
Incubate the tissue at 37°C for 10 min.
Tap and gently swirl the tube every 5 min during incubation.
Continue mechanical dissociation with a glass Pasteur pipette until tissue can be easily pipetted without difficulty (∼10 times).
Incubate the dissociated tissue at 37°C for another 10 min, tapping and swirling the tube every 5 min.
Place a 70 μM strainer on a 50 mL tube and wash the strainer with 1 mL of HBSS with calcium/magnesium.
Apply cell suspension to the prepared 70 μM strainer and add 10 mL of HBSS with calcium/magnesium to the strainer.
Discard the 70 μM strainer.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300×g for 10 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend cells with 1 mL of PEB buffer and transfer to a 1.5 mL tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension again at 300×g for 5 min at 4°C, aspirating the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 270 μL of PEB buffer.
Vortex CD31 MicroBeads bottle.
Add 30 μL of CD31 MicroBeads to the cell suspension.
Incubate cell suspension containing CD31 MicroBeads for 20 min at 4°C while being agitated on a rotator.
Add 1 mL of PEB buffer to cell suspension and centrifuge at 300×g for 5 min at 4°C.
Aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend pellet with 1 mL of PEB buffer.
Place LS columns on magnetic separator (MACS® MultiStand and QuadroMACS™ Separator) with a 15 mL collection tube, one per mouse.
Add 2 mL of PEB buffer to each LS column.
Warm 50 mL of endothelial cell culture medium at room temperature.
Apply cell suspension to LS column.
Wash columns 3 times with 0.5 mL of PEB buffer.
Discard total effluent.
Label 15 mL conical tubes.
Remove LS column from magnetic separator and place on labelled 15 mL conical tube.
Add 2 mL of endothelial cell culture medium to each LS column.
Immediately flush out endothelial cells by firmly pushing the plunger into the LS column.
Add 1 mL of endothelial cells to the 1× attachment factor coated 6-well plate and 1 mL of endothelial cell medium to each well.
Place plate in a 37°C incubator at 5% CO2.
Aliquot endothelial cell medium.
Let medium warm up at room temperature for 15 min.
Slowly aspirate endothelial medium from wells containing cells and replace with fresh medium.
Replace endothelial cell medium every second day until 80% confluence is reached.
Harvest primary endothelial cells.
Aliquot TrypLE™ Express Enzyme (1×) in a 15 mL conical tube (1 mL per well of a 6-well plate).
Incubate the aliquoted TrypLE™ at 37°C for 30 min.
Aliquot endothelial cell medium to match the volume of the TrypLE™ Express Enzyme used.
Aspirate old culture medium from endothelial cells and wash twice with sterile 1× PBS.
Add 1 mL of TrypLE™ Express Enzyme per well containing cells and place in a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator for 5 min.
Tap the plate after the 5-minute incubation to detach most cells; if needed, return plate to the incubator for an additional 2 minutes.
Add 1 mL of endothelial cell medium to each well containing detached cells and tap to mix thoroughly.
Transfer cells from each well to a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge the cells at 500×g for 5 min.
Aspirate supernatant from the centrifuged cells.
Resuspend cell pellet using endothelial cell medium.
Add 900 μL of resuspended cells to each cryovial.
Slowly add 100 μL of sterile DMSO to each cryovial and mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down.
Place cryovials containing the mixture in a Mr. Frosty™ freezing container.
Store the container at −80°C for 24 hours.
Transfer cryovials from the Mr. Frosty™ container to liquid nitrogen for long-term storage.
Prepare a 6-well plate coated with 1× attachment factor.
Warm 10 mL of endothelial cell medium at room temperature.
Aliquot 2 mL of pre-heated endothelial cell medium into a 15 mL conical tube.
Remove cryovial from liquid nitrogen and place in 37°C water bath for 1–2 minutes.
Transfer cells to the prepared 15 mL conical tube containing 2 mL of endothelial cell medium.
Centrifuge cells at 500×g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in endothelial cell medium.
Place cells into a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Replace endothelial cell medium every second day until 80% confluence is reached.
Prepare 50 mL of sterile 1× PBS and 0.5% BSA buffer.
Store the prepared buffer at −20°C for up to 4 weeks.
Resuspend cells with 180 μL of the stored sterile 1× PBS and 0.5% BSA buffer.
Transfer the resuspended cells to a 1.5 mL tube.
Add 20 μL of myelin removal beads to each tube.
Incubate at 4°C for 15 min while being agitated on a rotator.
Place LS columns on magnetic separator with a 15 mL collection tube.
Add 3 mL of sterile 1× PBS and 0.5% BSA buffer to each LS column.
Apply cell suspension to LS column.
Wash columns 2 times with 1 mL of sterile 1× PBS and 0.5% BSA buffer.
Collect unlabeled cells that pass through the column.
Centrifuge cell suspension in 15 mL collection tube at 300×g for 10 min.
Aspirate supernatant completely.
Resuspend cell pellet in 270 μL of PEB buffer and transfer to a new 1.5 mL tube.
Vortex CD45 MicroBeads bottle.
Add 30 μL of CD45 MicroBeads to cell suspension.
Incubate cell suspension containing CD45 MicroBeads for 20 min at 4°C while being agitated on a rotator.
Add 1 mL of PEB buffer to cell suspension and centrifuge at 300×g for 10 min at 4°C.
Aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend pellet with 500 μL of PEB buffer.
Place LD columns on magnetic separator with a 15 mL collection tube.
Add 2 mL of PEB buffer to each LD column.
Mix 1 mL of GTC Lysis buffer with 20 μL β-mercaptoethanol.
Prepare 1 mL of 70% ethanol.
Centrifuge 15 mL tubes containing endothelial cells at 500×g for 5 minutes and aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 350 μL of GTC Lysis buffer mixed with β-mercaptoethanol.
Vortex to mix thoroughly.
Insert RNA homogenizer mini columns into a 2 mL collection tube.
Transfer lysate to the RNA homogenizer mini column.
Centrifuge at 13,000×g for 1 minute.
Save filtrate and discard RNA homogenizer mini column.
Add 350 μL of 70% ethanol to the filtrate.
Vortex to mix thoroughly.
Insert a HiBlind® RNA mini column into a new 2 mL collection tube.
Transfer 700 μL sample to the HiBlind® RNA mini column.
Centrifuge at 10,000×g for 1 min.
Discard filtrate and reuse collection tube.
Prepare DNase I digestion mixture by adding 73.5 μL of E.Z.N.A.® DNase I digestion buffer and 1.5 μL of RNase-free DNase I (20Kunitz/μL) to a 1.5 mL tube.
Add 250 μL of RNA wash buffer I to HiBlind® RNA mini column of each sample.
Centrifuge at 10,000×g for 1 min.
Discard the filtrate and reuse collection tube.
Add 75 μL of DNase I digestion mixture directly to the surface of the membrane of the HiBlind® RNA mini column.
Let sit at room temperature for 15 min.
Add 250 μL RNA wash buffer I.
Let sit at room temperature for 2 min.
Centrifuge at 10,000×g for 1 min.
Discard filtrate and reuse collection tube.
Add 500 μL of RNA wash buffer II prepared with 100% ethanol to HiBlind® RNA mini column.
Centrifuge at 10,000×g for 1 min.
Discard filtrate and reuse collection tube.
Repeat step using RNA wash buffer II.
Centrifuge the empty HiBlind® RNA mini column at maximum speed for 2 min to dry the column.
Transfer HiBlind® RNA mini column to a clean 1.5 mL tube.
Add 60 μL of DNase-free water to HiBlind® RNA mini column.
Centrifuge at maximum speed for 2 min.
Pass eluted sample through HiBlind® RNA mini column a second time.
Centrifuge at maximum speed for 2 min.
Measure RNA concentration using Nanodrop.
Store eluted RNA at -80°C.
Prepare a 12-well plate for immunocytochemistry.
Add a 12 mm glass coverslip to each well of the 12-well plate.
Add 1 mL of 100% ethanol to each well containing a 12 mm glass coverslip.
Incubate for 1 h in sterile conditions.
Aspirate 100% ethanol and let dry.
Coat the 12-well plate containing 12 mm glass coverslips with 500 μL of 1× attachment factor.
Incubate for 30 min at room temperature in sterile conditions.
Aspirate 1× attachment factor and let dry.
Aliquot TrypLE™ Express Enzyme (1×) in a 15 mL conical tube, using 1 mL per well of a 6-well plate.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 min.
Aliquot endothelial cell medium with the same volume as TrypLE™ Express Enzyme (1×).
Aspirate old culture medium from endothelial cells and wash twice with sterile 1× PBS.
Aspirate 1× PBS.
Add 1 mL of TrypLE™ Express Enzyme (1×) per well containing cells.
Place in a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator for 5 min.
Tap the plate after 5-minute incubation.
If several cells are still attached to the plate, place the plate back in the 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator for 2 min.
Incubate samples.
Add 1 mL of endothelial cell medium to each well and tap plate to detach cells.
Transfer cells to a 15 mL conical tube and centrifuge for 5 min at 500×g.
Aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL of endothelial cell medium.
Count cells using a hemocytometer.
Seed cells at a density of 1 × 10^4 cells per well in a coated 12-well plate with a final volume of 1 mL per well.
Place 12-well plate containing cells in a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator for 3–4 days.
Replace endothelial cell medium every second day until 40%–60% confluence is reached.
Aspirate endothelial culture medium from 12-well plate containing cells once confluency is achieved.
Wash cells twice with 1 mL sterile 1× PBS.
Prepare 4% PFA in 1× PBS.
Add 500 μL of 4% PFA to 12-well plate containing 12 mm glass coverslips and cells.
Let incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Aspirate 4% PFA from cells after incubation.
Wash twice with 1 mL sterile 1× PBS.
Add 1 mL of sterile 1× PBS to each well.
Prepare blocking solution with 10% donkey serum, 0.5% fish gelatin in 0.1% PBST.
Add 500 μL of blocking solution to each well containing cells.
Incubate at room temperature for 60 minutes.
Aspirate the blocking solution from each well.
Dilute rabbit anti-VE-Cadherin primary antibody at a concentration of 1:500 in blocking solution and add 500 μL to each well.
Add 500 μL of rat anti-CD31 primary antibody diluted at a concentration of 1:200 in blocking solution to each well.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 hours while slowly agitating on an orbital shaker.
Wash cells three times with 2 mL of 0.2% PBST.
Aspirate the 0.2% PBST after washing.
Add 500 μL of donkey anti-rabbit IgG (H+L) highly cross-absorbed secondary antibody, Alexa Fluor 568 at a concentration of 1:300 to each well.
Add 500 μL of donkey anti-rat IgG (H+L) highly cross-absorbed secondary antibody, Alexa Fluor 488 at a concentration of 1:300 to each well.
Incubate the wells in a room temperature environment for 60 minutes while protected from light and slowly agitated on an orbital shaker.
Add 1 mL of DAPI in 0.1M PB solution at a concentration of 1:20,000 to each well.
Incubate for 5 min while protected from light.
Aspirate the DAPI solution.
Wash cells twice for 5 min with 1 mL of 0.1M PB.
Add approximately 10 μL of Fluoromount-G™ media on a slide.
Remove glass coverslip with cells from 12-well plate using forceps.
Dip broken coverslip in water and place face down on slide with Fluoromount-G™ drop if necessary.
Let the slide dry at room temperature for 1 hour while being protected from light.
Place slides at 4°C overnight to dry.
Image cells.
Coat a 96-well plate with 100 μL of 1× attachment factor.
Incubate the coated plate for 30 min at room temperature in sterile conditions.
Aspirate 1× attachment factor and let dry.
Harvest primary endothelial cells.
Aliquot TrypLE™ Express Enzyme (1×) in a 15 mL conical tube (1 ml per well of 6-well plate).
Incubate the aliquoted enzyme at 37°C for 30 min.
Aliquot endothelial cell medium in the same volume as TrypLE™ Express Enzyme (1×).
Aspirate old culture medium from endothelial cells.
Wash cells twice with sterile 1× PBS.
Aspirate 1× PBS.
Add 1 mL of TrypLE™ Express Enzyme (1×) per well containing cells.
Place the plate in a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator for 5 min.
Tap the plate after 5-minute incubation.
If necessary, place the plate back in the 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator for 2 min.
Add 1 mL of endothelial cell medium to each well and tap the plate to detach cells.
Transfer cells to a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 500×g.
Aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL of endothelial cell medium.
Count cells using a hemocytometer.
Seed cells at a density of 5 × 10^3 cells per well in coated 96-well plate with a final volume of 200 μL per well.
Place the 96-well plate containing cells in a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator for 48 h.
Visually confirm that cells have attached to the plate with 70%–80% confluence.
Treat 3–4 wells with 1 μM staurosporine for 6 h as positive control.
Remove media and replace with 5 μM of CellEvent™ Caspase-3/7 Green Detection Reagent diluted in endothelial cell medium to each well.
Incubate for 30 min in a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Wash cells twice using 100 μL sterile 1× PBS.
Fix endothelial cells using 100 μL of 2% paraformaldehyde for 30 min.
Wash cells twice using 100 μL sterile 1× PBS.
Stain nuclei using Hoechst 33342 following manufacturers protocol.
Image cells.
Add a 12 mm glass coverslip to each well of a 12-well plate.
Add 1 ml of 100% ethanol to each well containing a 12 mm glass coverslip and let incubate for 1 h in sterile conditions.
Aspirate 100% ethanol and let dry.
Coat 12-well plate containing 12 mm glass coverslip with 500 μL of 1× attachment factor and let incubate for 30 min at room temperature in sterile conditions.
After incubation, aspirate 1× attachment factor and let dry.
Aliquot TrypLE™ Express Enzyme in a 15 mL conical tube at 1 mL per well for a 6-well plate.
Incubate the aliquoted TrypLE™ Express Enzyme at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Aliquot endothelial cell medium at the same volume as the TrypLE™ Express Enzyme used.
Aspirate the old culture medium from the endothelial cells.
Wash the cells twice with sterile 1× PBS.
Aspirate the PBS after washing.
Add 1 mL of TrypLE™ Express Enzyme per well containing cells and place in a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator for 5 minutes.
Tap the plate gently after the 5-minute incubation.
Place back in the incubator for an additional 2 minutes if several cells are still attached.
Add 1 mL of endothelial cell medium to each well and tap to detach cells.
Transfer detached cells to a 15 mL conical tube and centrifuge at 500×g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant from the centrifuged cells.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL of endothelial cell medium.
Count cells using a hemocytometer.
Seed cells at a density of 5 × 10^3 cells per well in coated 12-well plates with a final volume of 1 mL per well.
Place the 12-well plate containing cells in a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator for 3–4 days.
Replace endothelial cell media every second day until approximately 60% confluence is reached.
Prepare a 20 mM stock solution of EdU by dissolving 5 mg of EdU in 1 mL of sterile 1× PBS.
Dilute 20 mM EdU in endothelial cell medium at a ratio of 5 μL EdU to 45 μL medium.
Add 10 μL of the diluted EdU solution to 490 μL of endothelial cell medium (final concentration 20 μM).
Remove 500 μL of endothelial cell medium from each well of a 12-well plate containing cells.
Add 500 μL of EdU at 20 μM to each well containing cells.
Incubate cells in a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator for 48 hours without changing the endothelial cell medium.
Prepare 4% PFA in 1× PBS.
Add 500 μL of 4% PFA to each well of the 12-well plate containing cells and glass coverslips.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Aspirate 4% PFA from cells and wash twice with 1 mL of 3% BSA in 1× PBS.
Add 1 mL of 0.5% Triton® X-100 in 1× PBS to each well.
Incubate at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Aspirate the 0.5% Triton® X-100 solution from each well.
Wash cells twice with 1 mL of 3% BSA in 1× PBS.
Add 0.5 mL of 1× Click-iT® reaction cocktail to each well containing cells.
Incubate plate for 30 min at room temperature, while protected from light.
Remove reaction cocktail and wash cells once with 1 mL of 3% BSA in 1× PBS.
Proceed to immunocytochemistry.
Image cells.
Take ten images using 20× objective.
Count EdU positive cells using the Cell Counter plugin in Fiji-Image J.
Prepare 96-well ImageLock plate.
Coat a 96-well ImageLock plate with 100 μL of 1× attachment factor.
Incubate the coated plate for 30 min at room temperature in sterile conditions.
Aspirate 1× attachment factor and let dry.
Harvest primary endothelial cells.
Aliquot TrypLE™ Express Enzyme (1×) in a 15 mL conical tube (1 mL per well of 6-well plate).
Incubate the aliquoted TrypLE™ at 37°C for 30 min.
Aliquot endothelial cell medium equal to the volume of TrypLE™ Express Enzyme.
Aspirate old culture medium from endothelial cells and wash twice with sterile 1× PBS.
Add 1 mL of TrypLE™ Express Enzyme (1×) per well containing cells.
Incubate the wells with TrypLE™ at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 5 min.
Incubate the plate for 5 minutes.
Tap the plate after incubation to detach most of the cells.
If several cells remain attached, return the plate to the 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator for 2 minutes.
Add 1 mL of endothelial cell medium to each well and tap the plate to detach any remaining cells.
Transfer detached cells to a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge the tube at 500×g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant from the centrifuged cells.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL of endothelial cell medium.
Count cells using a hemocytometer or an automated cell counter.
Seed cells at a density of 2 × 10^4 cells per well in coated 96-well ImageLock plates with a final volume of 100 μL per well.
Place the 96-well ImageLock plate containing cells in a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator for 48 hours.
Fill wash boat 1 with 45 mL of sterile water and place WoundMaker™ pin block in the solution for 5 minutes.
Fill wash boat 2 with 45 mL of 70% ethanol and place WoundMaker™ pin block in this solution for 5 minutes.
Place WoundMaker™ pin block on an empty wash boat.
Insert the 96-well ImageLock plate containing cells into the base plate holder.
Remove the plate cover.
Place WoundMaker™ pin block onto the base plate holding the cells.
Push and hold lever to create wounds.
Lift WoundMaker™ pin block and replace with 96-well ImageLock plate cover.
Aspirate and replace endothelial cell culture medium to remove floating cells.
Place 96-well ImageLock plate containing cells and 100 μL fresh media into the IncuCyte™ Zoom® apparatus to record cell migration.
Fill wash boat 4 with 45 mL of 0.5% Alconox and place WoundMaker™ pin block in solution for 5 min.
Fill wash boat 5 with 45 mL of 1% Virkon S. and place WoundMaker™ pin block in the solution for 5 min.
Fill wash boat 1 with 45 mL of sterile water and place WoundMaker™ pin block in water for 5 min.
Fill wash boat 2 with 45 mL of 70% ethanol and place WoundMaker™ pin block in the solution for 5 min.
Place WoundMaker™ on its base and store at room temperature.
Place a 96-well plate and 200 μL pipette tips at -20°C overnight.
Reduce growth factor Matrigel® should be placed at 4°C overnight for slow thawing.
Harvest primary endothelial cells when they reach 70-80% confluence.
Aliquot TrypLE™ Express Enzyme (1×) in a 15 mL conical tube, 1 ml per well of 6-well plate.
Incubate the aliquoted TrypLE™ Express Enzyme at 37°C for 30 min.
Aliquot endothelial cell medium, same volume as TrypLE™ Express Enzyme (1×).
Place 96-well plate and 200 μL pipette tips from -20°C freezer on ice in the biosafety cabinet along with growth factor reduced Matrigel®.
Aseptically aspirate old culture medium from endothelial cells.
Wash the cells twice with sterile 1× PBS.
Aspirate 1× PBS thoroughly.
Add 1 ml of TrypLE™ Express Enzyme (1×) per well containing cells and place in a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator for 5 min.
Incubate plate for 5 minutes.
Tap the plate after incubation.
Return plate to the 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator if several cells are still attached.
Add 50 μL of growth factor reduced Matrigel® per well to a cold 96-well plate during the 5-minute incubation period.
Remove any visible bubbles in wells containing growth factor reduced Matrigel®.
Ensure at least 40 μL of growth factor reduced Matrigel® remains in each well.
Place the 96-well plate with growth factor reduced Matrigel into a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator for 30 minutes.
Hold the neck of the Matrigel® bottle to reduce heat transfer during placement.
Prepare 3 wells of growth factor reduced Matrigel per mouse.
Keep the 96-well plate on ice until all wells are ready to be transferred to the incubator.
Incubate cells in endothelial cell medium for detachment after preparation of Matrigel®.
Add 1 mL of endothelial cell medium to each well of a 6-well plate and tap the plate to detach cells.
Transfer detached cells to a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge the conical tube at 500×g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant from the centrifuged cells.
Resuspend the cells in 1 mL of endothelial cell medium.
Count cells using a hemocytometer.
Optionally, count cells using an automated cell counter.
Seed 6 × 10^4 cells per mouse in a final volume of 450 μL of endothelial cell medium.
Prepare 3 wells of a 96-well plate for each mouse, with each well containing 2 × 10^4 cells.
Place one confluent well from a 6-well plate into the matrigel preparation in a 96-well plate after a 30-minute incubation.
Incubate the 96-well plate containing matrix and endothelial cells at 37°C with 5% CO2 until imaging time points (4 h, 8 h, 24 h, 48 h).
